sources.finding: ERCOT's RFI applies to all developers of 25MW-plus data centers pursuing ERCOT interconnection; the page gives an October 12 submission deadline and a December 10 ERCOT/PUCT report target, but names no projects or MW.
PJM describes a proposed, not effective, ride-through requirement for large computational loads and a planned November FERC filing; no project capacity allocation is disclosed.

The 2026-2030 plan names liquid cooling, 800V DC architecture and racks above 100kW, but predates the present window and requires a prior-public-record and policy-route check before an incremental public event.

The official policy-news summary calls for compute-power coordination and green-power-direct-connect projects, but is a summary; the underlying State Council record and binding status were not located in this scan.
